scope: Final shader-only repair; geometry/support/navigation-volume and all-old-file results are reused from the accepted r2 report, with current geometry metadata and shared source inputs independently checked.

strictDevelopedMask.method: Small independent GLSL-expression evaluator executes the emitted mask and all four output writes at developed-grid/boundary and actual terrain-vertex fragments, across arbitrary noise extrema; also verifies the expanded Three directional-shadow chunk differs only by the approved local bias.

receiverPlaneNumerics.method: Actual GLSL helper expressions evaluated independently against exact foreground GLB triangle coordinates projected by the inherited directional-light shadow matrix, at 1024/2048; zero/near-singular Jacobian, steep slope, negative determinant and zero-w guards also exercised.

borrowedResources.policy: Borrowed texture and unit-card geometry are not modified or disposed. Branch vertices/normals are copied from three existing tree prototypes.

openAreas.policy: Low meadow, no new tall trees
River edge stays low; trees at least ten metres behind the bank

metadata.heightMethod: Every root is raycast onto the actual unchanged terrain mesh; no new terrain, road or ground overlay plane.
metadata.groundMethod: Outside-only dry meadow/wet soil colour separation, 5m feathered leaf-litter understory around six copses, damp banks and restrained root contact; fade only at the approved outer envelope.

additionalGroundReceiverBias.method: Directional receiver-plane depth gradient covering the PCFSoft two-texel footprint at actual shadowMapSize
additionalGroundReceiverBias.mask: Per-fragment outside the developed rectangle only, fading to the outer envelope

metadata.unchanged: All original geometry, all 23 existing trees, public navigation, buildings, lights, fog, exposure and shadow frustum.

limitations: Real SPACE10 GLB and complete production setup10 → landscape11 environment are exercised; no save, render, browser or old source edits.

Local image/HDR reads are real, decode and GPU PMREM/CubeCamera are explicit CPU stubs. Leaf atlas uses the actual production paths through Windows System.Drawing. Visual/GPU quality is reviewed separately.
Actual instanced geometry is conservatively solid in sampled body-volume tests; this does not prove every continuous trajectory.
